item.title: fix(gateway): show one entry per subagent run in the tasks rail (#121…
item.summary: fix(gateway): show one entry per subagent run in the tasks rail (#121274) * fix(gateway): keep one task row per native subagent run A native sessions_spawn launch produced two background task rows for the same run: the gateway opened a `cli` row when it dispatched the child run, and the subagent registry then wrote the canonical `subagent` row for the same runId. Both rows point at the same child session, so one subagent run showed up twice in the tasks rail. Gateway CLI tracking is the fallback for runs nobody else records, and the plugin-subagent and ACP manual-spawn control planes already suppress it. Mark native child launches the same way so the subagent registry stays the single task owner for the run. Because the gateway now skips its fallback row for these launches, a failed registry registration would leave a run the gateway already accepted with no owner and no record. Abort the accepted run in that path so it cannot keep executing unrecorded. * chore(plugin-sdk): refresh api baseline for the task-owner marker The native subagent task-owner marker widens `GatewayClient.internal.agentRunTracking`, which plugins observe through `GatewayRequestHandlerOptions`.
